title: Build a Productboard alternative with Claude: free customer feedback inbox spec, 25/25 checks passed
description:
Claude built a Productboard alternative from one Markdown spec: all 25 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 157 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 20 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for a customer feedback inbox for teams of 3 to 50 people and had it build the tool in four phases: customers, people and the outbox; capture, the inbound endpoint and triage; themes, votes, promotion and the roadmap; and follow-ups and CSV export. The core rule: a theme's revenue counts each account once, so Acme Corp's two requests for single sign-on show 2 pieces of evidence but $2,400 of MRR, not $4,800, and a vote never adds revenue. The gaps included an outbox that no phase prompt built although later checks read it, live sign-in links an admin could see in that outbox, seed people with no email addresses and CSV exports with no exact columns. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when Productboard is still the better buy.
